parsed.use_case: A build orchestrator must determine whether a set of tasks can all run when some tasks depend on others. A circular dependency means the plan cannot complete.
system_examples: Apache Maven — checks project dependency relationships so modules can be built in a valid order and dependency cycles can be detected.
Kubernetes — orders resources with declared prerequisites in deployment workflows and must handle cyclic dependencies in those workflows.
parsed.explanation: Model courses and prerequisites as a directed graph; topological sorting or cycle detection takes O(V + E) time and space, versus checking possible course orders naively, which can grow factorially. The same dependency validation lets production schedulers reject impossible plans before execution; this problem’s direct industry use is common, though its course framing is educational.
